title: A new handbook treats analytical AI as a measurable data workflow
friendlyTitle: A practical guide for AI that sorts and checks information
summary: The Analytical AI Handbook lays out patterns for using models to classify, extract, score, normalize and judge information at scale. It emphasizes ground-truth datasets, evaluations, consistency, smaller adequate models and batch processing over defaulting to the largest model.
friendlySummary: This free handbook explains how to use AI for tasks such as classifying, extracting and scoring data. It focuses on testing results and choosing the smallest model that works well.
whyItMatters: Teams processing documents, support queues or operational data can use the guide to design AI work as a testable pipeline instead of an open-ended chatbot. That framing can improve reliability while reducing inference cost and latency pressure.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help teams build AI workflows that are easier to measure, cheaper to run and more consistent.
